mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_topic_progress (user_id, topic, study_minutes) VALUES (#{userId}, #{topic}, #{minutes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE study_minutes = study_minutes + VALUES(study_minutes)

INSERT INTO sa_topic_progress (user_id, topic, mastery, quiz_accuracy, wrong_count, quiz_question_count, correct_question_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{topic}, #{correct} * 100, #{correct} * 100, #{wrong}, 1, #{correct}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE wrong_count = wrong_count + VALUES(wrong_count), quiz_question_count = quiz_question_count + 1, correct_question_count = correct_question_count + VALUES(correct_question_count), quiz_accuracy = ROUND(correct_question_count * 100.0 / quiz_question_count, 2), mastery = ROUND(correct_question_count * 100.0 / quiz_question_count, 2)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, topic, mastery, quiz_accuracy, study_minutes, wrong_count, quiz_question_count, correct_question_count FROM sa_topic_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY mastery DESC, topic ASC
